integrity: The infinite-size theorem follows from an analytic triangular-array CLT and a parity-independence characteristic-function bound; exhaustive small-ring enumeration and non-exhaustive simulation are auxiliary. No external independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Static iid flipper disorder, fully aligned initial spins, fixed density p strictly between 0 and 1/2, logarithmic backward-from-half-recurrence windows. The finite variance formula and recurrence themselves are known; the contribution is the distributional Gaussian mixture and sharp transition. A relevant 2012 recurrence paper was not fully accessible.
title: A logarithmic Gaussian-mixture revival window in the Kac ring
